description: Visual multi-agent AI orchestration that runs on your Claude subscription. The drawing is the program.
##: The NSIS installer is unwrapped rather than executed: 7-Zip opens NSIS, and electron-builder
keeps the whole application inside as $PLUGINSDIR/app-64.7z. Both unwraps happen in
pre_install because scoop's AUTOMATIC archive extraction strips $PLUGINSDIR — the one
directory that matters here — so the download must arrive as a plain .exe and be opened by
hand. Nothing is ever executed, which is the point: no installer process, no SmartScreen.
In-app auto-update is the one thing this shape gives up: quitAndInstall would run the NSIS
installer and produce a SECOND copy in AppData. Update with: scoop update concentus.
notes: Update with: scoop update concentus  (the in-app updater is for the installed edition).
First launch asks how to pay for runs: your Claude subscription, or an Anthropic API key.
